Kashmir Government Faces Crisis as 24-25 MLAs Demand Cabinet Reshuffle

The government led by Omar Abdullah in Kashmir is reportedly facing a crisis, with 24 to 25 National Conference (NC) MLAs demanding a cabinet reshuffle. These MLAs have issued an ultimatum, reportedly giving the government 14 days to meet their demands. The MLAs allegedly held a secret meeting to prepare a plan, with some reports stating they are unwilling to accept the current situation unless the entire cabinet is changed.
